memories.author: D04
memories.text:
Gout: asymptomatic, serum uric acid pending. Plan: start allopurinol 100 mg OD after labs, colchicine 0.5 mg BD for flares.
Asthma: intermittent wheeze, salbutamol SOS, budesonide-formoterol 200/6 inhaler BD, montelukast 10 mg HS. Plan: continue.
Chronic urticaria: mild itching, levocetirizine 5 mg OD. Plan: continue.
Weight 68 kg, waist 84 cm (female cutoff 80 cm) – advise reduced carbohydrate diet.
Due: HbA1c not indicated; next review in 3 months.

memories.author: lab
memories.text: Serum uric acid 8.2 mg/dL (ref <7.0). Serum creatinine 0.9 mg/dL (0.6-1.2). CBC: WBC 6.2, Hb 12.8, platelets 210, eosinophils 4%. TSH 2.1 µIU/mL (0.4-4.0), free T4 1.2 ng/dL (0.8-1.8). Spirometry: FEV1 2.1 L (80% predicted), FVC 2.8 L, FEV1/FVC 75%; post-bronchodilator FEV1 2.3 L (88%).
